summary: Stephen Jenkins is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. Educated at Harvard University under doctoral supervisors Masatoshi Nagatomi and Charles Hallisey, he served as Professor of Religious Studies at California State Polytechnic University, Humboldt (attested 2010–2013).

Stephen Meredyth Edwardes (1873–1927) worked in Indology, history, and archaeology. He studied at Eton College and Christ Church, later serving as secretary of the Indo-British Association (~1917–1927) and editor of the Indian Antiquary (1923).

Stephen Montagu Burrows (1856–1935) was a scholar in the fields of history, archaeology, and Indology. He completed his education at Eton College (~1869–1874) and Exeter College, Oxford (~1875–1879, B.A.).

Stephen N. Hay (1925–2001) specialized in history, archaeology, and Indology, earning degrees from Swarthmore and Harvard. He taught history at the University of Chicago (1956–1964) and the University of California, Santa Barbara (1966–1991).

Stephen Prothero is a religious studies scholar who earned degrees from Yale and Harvard, completing his Ph.D. under William R. Hutchison. Around 1996, he joined Boston University, where he became Emeritus Professor of Religion in America.

Stephen R. Bokenkamp is a sinologist and religious studies scholar educated at UC Berkeley. He taught Classical Chinese at Indiana University Bloomington (~1989–2007) before becoming Professor of Chinese at Arizona State University (~2007).
Stephen Suen is a scholar of Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2009) under the doctoral supervision of K. L. Dhammajoti.

Stephen Wootton Bushell (1844–1908) was a sinologist, historian, and archaeologist. He studied at Guy's Hospital and the University of London (MD), working as a hospital surgeon and medical officer before serving as physician to the British Embassy, Beijing (1868–1900).

Steve Odin is a scholar of philosophy and Japanology who studied under David A. Dilworth and Edward S. Casey at Stony Brook University. In 1982, he was appointed Professor of Philosophy at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa.

Steven Collins (1950–2018) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who completed his D.Phil. at Oxford under Richard Gombrich. He held posts at Bristol and Indiana University before becoming Chester D. Tripp Professor at the University of Chicago.

Steven Edward Lindquist is a scholar of Indology and religious studies who earned his Ph.D. from the University of Texas at Austin in 2005 under Patrick Olivelle. He later held an academic post at Concordia University.

Steven Heine is a Buddhist studies and religious studies scholar who earned his PhD at Temple University in 1980. He taught at Villanova, La Salle, and Penn State before becoming Professor at Florida International University in 1997.

Steven Lukes is a sociologist and philosopher educated at Balliol and Nuffield Colleges, Oxford. He was a fellow at Balliol (1966–1987), held professorships in Florence, Siena, and the LSE, and became a professor at New York University (~2002–2021).

Steven Neal Weinberger is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. Educated at Amherst College and the University of Virginia, where he earned his MA and PhD under Jeffrey Hopkins, he held an affiliation with the University of Virginia (attested 2006).

Steven Vose is a scholar of Indology, religious studies, and history who completed his PhD at the University of Pennsylvania (2013). He has held faculty posts at Florida International University, Colorado College, and the University of Colorado Denver.
Stewart McFarlane is a scholar in religious studies, Buddhist studies, and sinology. He held an academic post in the Department of Religious Studies at Lancaster University (attested 1991 and 2001).

Sthaneshwar Timalsina is a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and religious studies educated at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and Martin Luther University. He taught at Nepal Sanskrit University and San Diego State University before taking an endowed chair at Stony Brook University (~2022).
Sthira Bhattacharya is a scholar of Indology, history, and archaeology. She completed her PhD at the University of Chicago (2019–2026), where she became a Postdoctoral Teaching Fellow in 2026.

Stig Wikander (1908–1983) was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Uppsala under Henrik Samuel Nyberg. He served as docent at Lund University and held the Chair of Sanskrit and Comparative Indo-European Philology at Uppsala University (1953–1974).

Stuart Edward Mann (1905–1986) was a linguist and Indologist who studied Germanic studies at the University of Bristol. He taught English at Masaryk University (~1931–1939) and Czech and Albanian at the School of Slavonic and East European Studies (1947–1972).
